# Quantum Singularity

> Real-time WebGL 2 particle instrument: up to 110,000 GPU particles steered by on-device hand-gesture recognition (MediaPipe), live microphone audio (Web Audio) and the pointer. A static site built from native ES modules with no build step and no backend; camera and microphone data never leave the browser.

Quantum Singularity is an interactive computational-art piece and an engineering reference for procedural GPU rendering, on-device ML input fusion, frame-rate-independent state machines and testable browser architecture.

## Quick Links

- [Live Demo](https://animation-zeta-rosy.vercel.app/): runs in any current browser with WebGL 2.
- [Full specification (llms-full.txt)](https://animation-zeta-rosy.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): topologies, gesture pipeline, audio DSP, quality tiers, security and testing, with the real constants from the source.
- [Architecture](https://animation-zeta-rosy.vercel.app/ARCHITECTURE.md): module map, render pipeline, gesture and audio pipelines.
- [Validation Report](https://animation-zeta-rosy.vercel.app/VALIDATION.md): test layers, coverage and the regressions they guard.
- [Changelog](https://animation-zeta-rosy.vercel.app/CHANGELOG.md): release history.
- [Source Code](https://github.com/Ibrahim-Salman19/quantum-singularity): GitHub repository, MIT licensed.

## Core Technical Highlights

- **Procedural GPU particles**: the particle field has no position buffer. The vertex shader derives each position from a shuffled per-particle index (`aIndex`), a seed and a jet polarity, across 6 topologies with smooth morphing.
- **Seeded Fisher-Yates index shuffle**: decorrelates buffer order from spatial position, so trimming the draw range under load thins the field uniformly instead of clipping its outer edge.
- **Gesture fusion**: MediaPipe's gesture classifier is blended with an orientation-invariant landmark-geometry classifier. Geometry weight is 0.30-0.46 depending on palm-normal quality, with agreement boosts and a "None" veto.
- **Time-based gesture state machine**: EMA smoothing (45 ms attack, 130 ms release) plus activate/switch/hold/release hysteresis expressed in seconds, so behaviour is identical at 30 and 144 Hz. Each sample's confirm contribution is capped, so confirmation needs at least two agreeing samples even at 8 Hz inference.
- **4-band audio DSP**: sub-bass 20-80 Hz, mid-bass 80-250 Hz, mids 250-2000 Hz, treble 2-8 kHz, with an adaptive onset detector (bass > 1.4 × running average + 0.05, 140 ms cooldown).
- **Adaptive quality**: device and GPU classification (software, integrated, discrete) picks a tier at boot; pixel ratio and particle count then follow measured frame time. `?quality=minimal|low|medium|high` pins a tier.
- **Privacy**: camera and microphone are opt-in and processed locally. No analytics or cookies. Three.js and MediaPipe load from pinned CDN versions with SRI; the gesture model is fetched once from Google model storage and cached.

## Topologies

1. **Singularity accretion**: golden-angle disk with radius-dependent rotation and bipolar jets.
2. **Quantum lotus**: Fibonacci-sphere lattice with a 7-fold petal modulation that slowly folds and unfolds.
3. **4D tesseract**: the 16 vertices of a hypercube, rotated in two 4D planes and perspective-projected to 3D.
4. **Clifford attractor**: a stylised closed-form attractor shell (a perturbed spherical spiral, not an iterated map) whose harmonics scale with the Chaos control.
5. **Hopf fibration**: fibres of S³ → S², stereographically projected into nested, linked circles.
6. **Lorenz manifold**: a closed-form parametrisation of the two Lorenz-attractor wings (not a numerical integration).

## Keyboard Controls

- `1`-`6`: switch topology
- `H`: guide · `B`: build notes · `P`: performance stats (GPU time, draw calls)
- `F`: focus mode · `C`: copy share link · `R`: reset controls · `Space`: pause · `Esc`: close panel

## Technology Stack

- **Graphics**: Three.js 0.185.1 (SRI-pinned), WebGL 2, custom GLSL shaders, bloom and a cinematic post pass.
- **Machine learning**: MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.35 (WASM, on-device).
- **Audio**: Web Audio API AnalyserNode.
- **Testing**: 137 Node unit tests (≈99.8 % line coverage of logic modules), 91 Playwright browser tests, 11-check static audit, all gated in GitHub Actions.
- **Delivery**: static files on Vercel, strict CSP (no `'unsafe-inline'` script), HSTS, same-origin camera/microphone policy.
